##### Project general facts

Al Haseen Residences 3 is a contemporary residential development by Dugasta Properties designed to offer a modern and practical living experience. The project features contemporary architecture, efficient layouts, and thoughtfully planned residences that cater to a variety of lifestyle needs. Emphasizing quality construction and functional design, the development is created to provide comfortable living spaces with a focus on everyday convenience, modern aesthetics, and long-term residential value.

Residents benefit from a selection of amenities designed to support leisure, relaxation, and community living. The development incorporates communal facilities and recreational spaces that enhance the residential experience, creating a comfortable environment suited to both individuals and families. The amenity offering is designed to promote convenience, well-being, and a balanced lifestyle.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interior spaces are designed with contemporary aesthetics and durable finishes that combine style with functionality. Kitchens come fully equipped with appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern residential standards with an emphasis on quality, comfort, and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Saih Shuaib 2 is an emerging district that attracts attention for its spacious layout, low-density environment, and strong long-term growth potential. Unlike many of Dubai’s more densely developed neighborhoods, the area offers wide roads, open spaces, and a calmer atmosphere, making it appealing to residents who value privacy and a less congested lifestyle. Ongoing infrastructure improvements and continuous development in the surrounding southern corridor position the district as one of the city’s promising growth areas.

One of the key advantages of Saih Shuaib 2 is its strategic role within Dubai’s expanding economic landscape. The area benefits from proximity to major logistics, aviation, and industrial hubs, creating a stable demand base and supporting long-term investment potential. Large-scale government-backed development initiatives in the wider region continue to drive growth, while the availability of residential plots, villas, townhouses, and apartments provides flexibility for both end-users and investors. Compared to many established areas, property prices remain relatively accessible, offering attractive value and future appreciation opportunities.

The district is also becoming increasingly appealing as a residential community. Modern infrastructure, gated developments, landscaped areas, parks, jogging tracks, BBQ zones, and family-oriented facilities contribute to a comfortable lifestyle. The peaceful setting, combined with a growing selection of residential projects and community amenities, makes Saih Shuaib 2 particularly attractive for families, professionals, and buyers seeking a balance between affordability, space, and future growth. As development in the surrounding area progresses, the district is expected to continue evolving into a more complete and self-sustained community.
